children: Plains GP Holdings announced that subsidiary Plains All American Pipeline completed a $1.5 billion public offering of junior subordinated notes due 2056 under a new subordinated indenture with U.S. Bank Trust Company. The issuance includes $700 million of 6.750% Series A Notes and $800 million of 7.000% Series B Notes, with interest payable semiannually beginning June 15, 2027. Rates reset on specified five-year schedules with floors at initial coupons, and the notes are redeemable at set periods. The notes are unsecured and junior to senior indebtedness.
: Subordinated indenture and issuance of junior subordinated notes due 2056
: Enhance long-term capital structure and financial flexibility
